paragraphs.hr: Moje ime je Mia. Ja sam studentica. Studiram engleski jezik na Filozofskom fakultetu u Zagrebu. Imam dvadeset godina. Živim u studentskom domu — mali je, ali dovoljan za jednu osobu.
paragraphs.en: My name is Mia. I am a student. I study English language at the Faculty of Humanities in Zagreb. I am twenty years old. I live in a student dormitory — it is small, but enough for one person.

paragraphs.hr: Svako jutro ustajem u sedam sati. Idem u kupaonicu — perem lice i zube. Oblačim se i idem na doručak. Doručak je uvijek isti: jogurt i voće. Pijem čaj, ne kavu. Kava je preskupa za studenta.
paragraphs.en: Every morning I get up at seven o'clock. I go to the bathroom — I wash my face and teeth. I get dressed and go to breakfast. Breakfast is always the same: yoghurt and fruit. I drink tea, not coffee. Coffee is too expensive for a student.

paragraphs.hr: U osam i pol idem na fakultet tramvajem. Nastava počinje u devet. Danas imam tri predmeta: gramatiku, književnost i prevođenje. Predavaonice su velike i ima puno studenata. Moji profesori su dobri — jasno govore i puno objašnjavaju.
paragraphs.en: At half past eight I go to the faculty by tram. Classes start at nine. Today I have three subjects: grammar, literature and translation. The lecture rooms are large and there are many students. My professors are good — they speak clearly and explain a lot.

paragraphs.hr: U podne imam pauzu. Idem u kantinu s prijateljicom Anom. Ručak košta tri eura — nije skupo. Jedemo brzo jer moramo nazad na nastavu u jedan sat. Ana je zabavna i uvijek me nasmije. Ona studira povijest.
paragraphs.en: At noon I have a break. I go to the canteen with my friend Ana. Lunch costs three euros — it is not expensive. We eat quickly because we have to be back in class at one o'clock. Ana is fun and always makes me laugh. She studies history.

paragraphs.hr: Navečer učim u sobi ili u knjižnici. Imam puno zadaća i ispit sljedeći tjedan. U deset sati navečer idem spavati. Studentski život nije lak, ali ja volim studirati. Moj san je raditi kao prevoditeljica. Svaki dan radim malo na tom cilju.
paragraphs.en: In the evening I study in my room or in the library. I have a lot of homework and an exam next week. At ten o'clock in the evening I go to sleep. Student life is not easy, but I love studying. My dream is to work as a translator. Every day I work a little towards that goal.
